# CartGenerator 0.5.5 macOS Maintenance Release
Release date: 2026-10-08 Platform: macOS arm64 Distribution: ad-hoc-signed direct-download DMG (not notarized)
## Artifact
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.5-macOS-arm64.dmg` - Size: 258 MB - SHA-256: `fc0bb5a7eba7b99816034f03901f5d60726a79a1c73bf65cbbad2d12ad604330`
## Main changes
- Added clear loading and unavailable states for part thumbnails using normalized Phosphor icons. - Exact-color searches now include the target-site color term, preventing valid parts such as 6091 Tan from being discarded by broad search-page limits. - Shortened partial-quantity details and distinguished sold-out products from other purchase-planning failures. - Added a macOS Qt WebEngine accessibility crash guard for the Qt 6.11 Cocoa accessibility failure observed after an otherwise completed job. - Simple confirmations, recovery choices, diagnostic notices, update notices, and generic errors now use standard macOS alerts. - Native-alert creation is restricted to an initialized QApplication on its GUI thread.
## Known issue
- In the Web UI, the hidden native `カートを空にする` compatibility button can still appear as a separate small macOS window when an existing non-empty cart enters the cart-wait state. The cart operation remains confirmation-gated, but this visual defect is not fixed in 0.5.5.
## Verification performed
- 252 Python tests passed before release packaging. - Python compilation and diff checks passed. - AppKit availability and the native destructive-button API were verified without creating controls outside the application lifecycle. - No real cart was cleared, resumed, or modified for this release.
## Installation
Use Help -> Check for Updates in CartGenerator 0.5.4, or install the DMG over the previous version.
## Source archive
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.5-source.tar.gz` - SHA-256: `70b8c7f01da0ae4ddca6896a9bfa691ebff6eda49282f5a9e8bd51c158164ef5`
## Automatic updates
After publication, the signed Sparkle feed will offer 0.5.5 to earlier installations.
